message.content: Jake Watson, in his conversation with Li Hua, emphasizes the importance of flexibility in a soccer player's fitness routine. He suggests that flexibility is an area of focus for further development in Li Hua's fitness routine, alongside strength training. Jake specifically mentions that proper warm-up and stretching are key before any game to improve flexibility and reduce the risk of injuries. This aligns with the content shared in the first source where Jake advises Li Hua on the importance of warm-up, stretching, hydration, and wearing appropriate footwear to prevent injuries, highlighting the role of flexibility in maintaining overall fitness and performance.
